stem.text: Which diagram best illustrates the electric field around a positive point charge?

A.alt: Concentric circular lines with arrowheads around a central circle marked +.

B.alt: Concentric circular lines with arrowheads around a central circle marked +.

C.alt: Radial lines with arrowheads around a central circle marked +.

D.alt: Radial lines with arrowheads around a central circle marked +.
